page.overview:
Who is Aero-Viper?

Aero-Viper belongs to G.I. Joe. !style="border:1px solid black" colspan=2|Generation 1 Aero-Vipers were available in the 1989 series of A Real American Hero toys, packaged with the Condor Z-25.

---- Appearance: black cap; black hair and beard; dark green flight suit with grey straps and gloves; black waistpiece with gold circles; black boots Accessories: gold, insectoid full-head helmet. ---- YoJoe.com page/Filecard

In G.I. Joe, Aero-Viper sits among related figures, places, and turning points that give the entry its encyclopedia trail.
